title: The gym owner is not told when MettleUp opens emergency access to the gym's records
what: When MettleUp support opens emergency access, the server only writes the opening into a list and an audit row. No message, bell or pop-up goes to the owner. The owner finds out only if they happen to open the support access list in the admin app, which may be after the 15 to 60 minutes are already over.
expected: The moment support opens emergency access, the owner gets a notice in the admin app (and a pop-up where allowed) saying who opened it, why and until when.
fix_line: Send the owner a notice in the admin app's bell, and a pop-up where allowed, each time emergency access opens

title: Switching an automatic reminder off does not stop reminders members' phones have already set
what: The owner's reminder switches live on the server, but the server never tells a phone that they changed: each member's phone reads them when it next checks the gym and sets its reminders days ahead from what it last read. If the owner turns the birthday wish or 'plan ends soon' off, or changes its days, a member whose phone has not read the gym since still gets the old reminder.
expected: Once the owner switches a reminder off or changes its days, no member gets the old one.
how_often: whenever the owner changes a switch and a member's phone has not read the gym since
fix_line: When the owner saves the switches, wake members' phones so they re-plan their reminders, and tell the owner changes reach phones within a day

title: A reminder the owner never touched follows whatever each app version thinks the default is
what: The server keeps only the switches the owner changed. A reminder the owner left alone is decided by the built-in default of each member's app version, and the admin app shows its own default. If a newer app changes a default, the owner's screen and members on different versions can disagree, and the owner cannot tell.
expected: Every reminder has one stated on or off value that the owner's screen and every member phone read the same way.
how_often: after any app update that changes a default
fix_line: Keep the full set of switches, defaults filled in, on the server and hand phones that full set

title: A member's phone is told 'all fine' with no dates, so nobody learns why birthday, welcome and plan reminders never come
what: The reminder data for a member's phone answers 'ok' even when the member's number was never proven at a QR check-in, the first name in the app does not match the gym's list, or two members share the number. The birthday, joining date and plan are simply left empty and the reason is thrown away. The phone cannot show the member 'check in once at the desk to get your reminders', so the member silently gets no birthday wish, welcome or plan-ending reminder.
expected: When a member cannot get the gym's reminders, their phone is told why and shows one plain line on how to fix it.
how_often: every member without a proven number or with a name mismatch
fix_line: Hand the phone the reason (no check-in yet, name differs, shared number) and show it under the gym reminders switch
